tools.name: thruact_discover
tools.description: Find capabilities for a job, with prices and measured reliability. Search first, execute second.

tools.name: thruact_act
tools.description: Run a capability. Routes across providers and fails over automatically on provider faults. The reply's `route` says which providers were considered, what each scored, and why any were not used — including ones dropped for a missing credential.

tools.name: thruact_compare
tools.description: Ask every provider behind a capability the same question at once and report where their answers differ. Use it when the answer matters enough to want it corroborated. Costs more than act: every provider called is paid.

tools.name: thruact_call
tools.description: Run one specific tool by id. No failover.

tools.name: thruact_iq
tools.description: Measured reliability per tool over the last 7 days.

tools.name: thruact_proxy
tools.description: Send an authenticated request to a third-party vendor the workspace has connected. The stored API key is injected server-side — you never see it. Give the vendor id from the directory (e.g. openai, sendgrid), an HTTP method, and a path on that vendor's own API. Use it to act through a connected vend
